description: Retrained model weights and derived outputs for ARXIS validation. Generated on the REAL Gas_Sensors_Measurements.csv (single corpus). Original models/ weights untouched. Last refreshed: 2026-08-31 (post re-run).
note: On 2026-08-31 the exp1_pareto/*.pth checkpoints were re-saved in DecisionTool-compatible wrapped format (model_state_dict + input_dim/n_actions/sensor_cols/all_feat_cols + anom_p1/anom_p99/feat_scaler_mean/feat_scaler_scale). The scale constants are NOT arbitrary: each is exactly what raw_pipeline.prepare() computed on that seed's block_wise_holdout training split, so the model reconstructs the same 22-dim state at inference it saw during training.
training_objective: IMPORTANT: every exp1_pareto and exp2_comparators checkpoint is trained by COST-WEIGHTED CROSS-ENTROPY against the rule-oracle action, inside a DuelingDQN-shaped network. There is no replay buffer, no target network, no n-step return, no epsilon-greedy exploration and no temporal-difference bootstrap in these checkpoints. The only checkpoint trained with a genuine RL objective is the CQL agent in retrain/zoo.py (TD(0) Bellman target + conservative logsumexp penalty), which exists as a comparator. Any document describing these weights as DQN-trained is wrong.

checkpoints.retrained/exp1_pareto/: 40 DuelingDQN .pth (8 cost ratios x 5 seeds), cost-weighted CE, DecisionTool-compatible wrapped format with per-seed scale keys
checkpoints.retrained/exp1_pareto/exp1_baseline_1to1: 5 DuelingDQN plain-CE (1:1 floor) checkpoints, same format

results.exp1_pareto.csv: Exp #1 reward-asymmetry Pareto frontier. Accuracy PEAKS at 6:1 (0.9658 +/- 0.0274); 8:1 is 0.9633 +/- 0.0215 and is the deployed ratio because it has the tighter seed spread. Every ratio from 1:1 to 16:1 attains miss_rate = 0.0; 20:1 collapses to 0.8396. Do not describe 8:1 as the accuracy peak.
results.exp3_loco.csv: Exp #3 leave-one-class-out (16 rows: 4 classes x 4 models). Each row from a completed model training. See NOTE_provenance_exp3.md. NOTE: acc_mean is 0.0 in every cell by construction (a held-out class's correct action is never in the training target set); the informative columns are miss_mean and escalation_mean.
results.exp3_clopper_pearson.csv/.json: Exact 95% one-sided upper bounds on danger-miss, reported PER (model, held-out class). Zero-miss pairs bound at 0.1893%; A_decision_agent on held-out Mixture (7/1581) bounds at 0.83%; D_mlp on held-out Smoke (296/1581) bounds at 20.41%. REPLACES an earlier version that reported one 0.1893% row per class with no model column and therefore applied the best model's bound to every model.
results.exp4_calibration.csv: Exp #4 calibration, RE-RUN 2026-08-31 after the calibration-split / ensemble-fit fixes. Valid to quote. Caveat: raw and temp-scaled ECE are dominated by seed 42 (raw 0.174 vs 0.009-0.023 for the other four seeds), so mean +/- std is not a fair summary for those two rows; the deep ensemble is the only stable estimator (0.0123 +/- 0.0043).
results.expzoo.csv: Exp ZOO comparators, RE-RUN 2026-08-31 after the LSTM window/dropout fixes. Valid to quote. No comparison reaches significance at n=5 seeds (best p = 0.1875, RF); RF attains the highest accuracy (0.9769 +/- 0.0086).

known_open_items: Exp #3 was aggregated from independent per-class trainings, not one uninterrupted run (Cygwin fork limit). See NOTE_provenance_exp3.md.
